d:
“darpan ko dekha tune” ek khoobsurat aur dil ko chhu jane vala romantic song hai jo 70’s Bollywood ki evergreen melodies mein se ek hai. Is gaane ko apni soulful awaaz di hai legendary singer Mukesh ji ne.
Film Upaasna (1971) ka yeh classic track Feroz Khan aur Mumtaz par filmaya gaya hai, jo pyaar aur ehsaas ko bahut hi nazakat se dikhata hai.
Agar aapko purane Hindi gaane, retro romantic songs aur Old Is Gold classics pasand hain, toh yeh gaana zaroor enjoy karein
